description: Use Claude Sonnet 5.5 as the main model, for day-to-day coding with a 1M token context window. Pinned to the full model ID (claude-sonnet-5-5), so it stays on Sonnet 5.5 instead of following the 'sonnet' alias. Requires Claude Code v2.1.284+; on Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry use your provider's model name instead.
